messages.content: You check claims about a scientific paper against the evidence each one cites. A claim is supported only if the cited evidence says it AS WRITTEN: the same subject, row, column, setting and number. A correct value attached to the wrong subject or row is NOT supported, and neither is a claim that goes beyond its evidence. Judge only from the cited evidence; figure images are attached where a claim cites a figure. Give a verdict for every claim.

Claims:
1. "While not all reflection details are reproduced, the results are free of color shifts around the highlights and mostly a low-frequency approximation of the environment reflected." -- cites: E1 (Figure 9): quote "while not all reﬂection details are reproduced, ours is free of color shifts around the highlights and mostly a low- frequency approximation of the environment reﬂected."

Cited evidence:
[E1] (figure, Figure 9, page 8) (image attached): Figure 9. Results of joint material segmentation and estimation for two samples (rows) . In every part we show a re-synthesis, as well as two estimated materials and the resulting mask. The insets in the last row show that, while not all reﬂection details are reproduced, ours is free of color shifts around the highlights and mostly a low- frequency approximation of the environment reﬂected. [image]

verdicts.reason: The cited evidence explicitly states in the caption that 'while not all reﬂection details are reproduced, ours is free of color shifts around the highlights and mostly a low- frequency approximation of the environment reﬂected.'
